d:
At least 17 people have died after allegedly consuming spurious liquor in Manipur, including 16 from Chandel district. Reporting from a village in Chakpikarong subdivision of Chandel, a family member recounts losing his brother, saying they did not even get an opportunity to take him to hospital.
Watch this Ground Report by Samridhi Tewari and Praveen Jain.
